notes.title: Announcement of Pre-Collage Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for enjoying "Pre-Collage -IDOLIZED-".
Today, we have updated the software to ver. 1.01.

The changes are as follows
Correction of some wording
Fixed an inconvenience in DM scene
Changed Todo list release conditions
Modification of comment release conditions
Fixed some screen display irregularities

Please continue to enjoy "Precollage -IDOLIZED-".
